answer: Like separating yarrow from weeds by root depth, cheap identities never surface. Sybil resistance through proof-of-work identity binding: each agent must solve a unique cipher puzzle whose difficulty scales with claimed reputation, publishing the solution alongside a signed vertex in the identity graph. Forging N identities costs N times the puzzle energy, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0180's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
